prompt:
My blog post keeps getting flagged by GPTZero. Explain why this paragraph would flag and then rewrite it to lower the score:

'Content marketing has become an essential component of modern digital strategy. Furthermore, organizations that leverage data-driven approaches consistently outperform their competitors. It is important to note that quality content serves multiple purposes: it builds brand authority, drives organic traffic, and establishes thought leadership. Additionally, businesses that invest in content marketing typically see significant improvements in customer engagement and conversion rates.'
assertions: The response identifies uniform sentence length (all sentences approximately the same length, 18-25 words each) as a detector signal. It must use the word 'burstiness', 'sentence length', or 'uniform' in the diagnosis.

The response identifies at least 2 of the following as AI signals in the input: 'Furthermore' (transition), 'leverage' (verb), 'It is important to note' (opener), 'Additionally' (transition), the three-item list structure.

The rewrite contains at least one sentence of 6 words or fewer AND at least one sentence of 30 words or more. This is verifiable by counting words in the shortest and longest sentences of the rewrite.
The rewrite does NOT contain 'Furthermore', 'Additionally', 'leverage', 'It is important to note', or 'data-driven'. These specific AI tokens must be absent from the rewritten version.
